source: assets-src/saturn/shot/polar_rings.py, the hero's ring pixels on the ring plane (azimuth by radius), bands straightened and gaps filled

margin.note: the outer margin of the B ring in the hero's ring pixel map, laid again along the bands by assets-src/saturn/code/polar_margin.py. radius: the rows it takes in (in from the first to the second, out from the third to the fourth, planet radii); azimuth: the sector it takes in, degrees in the body frame (in from the first to the second, out from the third to the fourth); from: the clean sector the fine structure comes from, mirrored back and forth; low: the width in degrees of the blur along the azimuth that parts level from fine structure; level: the width in degrees at the clean sector's near end whose mean is the level of each row; quality: of the file written
